messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — Acme Health is asking for a POC package today. They want: ephemeral API keys, an audit log bundle they can ingest into Datadog, egress IPs for firewall allowlisting, and confirmation of SSO + SCIM for test users. Also attached: a security questionnaire (see link). Can we scope what we can deliver for a 2-week POC?

Maya: We can do most of this. For hosted: scoped API keys with TTL (default 30d) and we can mint a 14d key. We can export an audit bundle as newline-delimited JSON to a pre-signed S3 URL or push to a customer Datadog HTTP intake.

Maya: For Dedicated: need subnet IDs and an allowlist of egress IPs (see ranges below). We'll need the CIDR for their internal monitoring collector if they want HEC.

Maya: For Private (VPC): we'll need VPN / peering details + routing table info. Private deploys also allow KMS-managed keys.

Rishi: Quick security checks: is the audit bundle sanitized (no PII) by default? And confirm at-rest encryption uses CMKs for Private/Dedicated. Also, what's the signature/time range on the presigned S3 bundle?

Maya: Audit bundle is op-level metadata only — request/response hashes, model id, timestamps, tokens burned, route id. We do NOT include customer payload by default. If Acme requests payloads for debugging, we need an approved DPA change. Presigned S3 URLs default to 24h expiry but we can extend to 7d for POC.

Elena: Pricing question from the buyer: estimate for a 2-week Dedicated pool (n1-standard-ish) for ~50 req/s peak. Also any add-on for retention of logs beyond default 30 days?

Maya: Ballpark for a small Dedicated test pool: monthly commit converted prorata is roughly $6k/month — so ~$3k for 2 weeks. If they prefer Hosted, no commit but unit costs apply. We can provide an interim log retention add-on (90/180d) as a temporary config — note that longer retention may need enterprise log add-on.

Jordan: Can we package a sample 'POC audit bundle' so Acme can validate ingestion into Datadog ahead of the test start? Also timeline for getting a 14d scoped key and egress IPs to them?

Maya: Yes — I'll generate a synthetic bundle and upload to a pre-signed S3 link by EOD. Scoped API key can be created in ~15m once I have the customer account id. Egress IP ranges below (these are our NAT exit ranges for the desired region): `3.120.45.0/24`, `3.120.46.0/24`, `3.120.47.0/24`. Please confirm you can share the CIDR for their listener.

Sam: I've uploaded the security questionnaire to the shared drive and sent to Acme legal. Link: https://redwood.example.com/poc-acme/sec-questionnaire (internal). Acme asked for SAML metadata and SCIM examples — do we have a sample SAML metadata xml and SCIM user payload?

Maya: SAML metadata + SCIM examples here: https://redwood.example.com/internal/sso-examples. SCIM provisioning for POC: we can enable SCIM on the tenant and send a test user list (CSV -> SCIM sync). It takes ~1 hour to set up with their IdP provided metadata.

Rishi: Encryption at rest: Hosted uses our default service-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private can bring-your-own CMK (BYOK) per contract. In-transit TLS is enforced for all endpoints.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created scoped-key temp-abc123 for tenant=acme-poc (expires 2026-04-05T16:00:00Z) :rocket:

Jordan: Awesome, thanks. Next actions: 1) Maya uploads synthetic audit bundle + Datadog sample ingest config, 2) Sam shares Acme subnet/CIDR, 3) legal to review questionnaire. I'll coordinate kickoff once the key and bundle are live. :thumbsup:
